// diagnostic

E1136

`{name}.reflect().uses` is read outside the package that declares `{name}`.

What

`{name}.reflect().uses` is read outside the package that declares `{name}`.

Why

A marker's uses span every package that writes it, so only the marker's own package reads them.

Fix

Read `{name}.reflect().uses` inside the package that declares `{name}`, and export what it builds from them.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1136: tests/ui/marker_uses_outside_package/stderr.

Error [jet.MarkerUsesOutsidePackage]: `routes.Route.reflect().uses` is read outside the package that declares `routes.Route`

    |
  8 | COUNT: #run routes.Route.reflect().uses.len()
    |                                    ^^^^
 Why: A marker's uses span every package that writes it, so only the marker's own package reads them
 Fix: Read `routes.Route.reflect().uses` inside the package that declares `routes.Route`, and export what it builds from them
